description: Manifest of secret-scanning .tmpl files emitted into each generated wrapper project (issue #52). Drops a defense-in-depth setup: gitleaks pre-commit hook + tuned ruleset + secret-scan CI workflow + baseline build/test CI. Tokens are deliberately empty -- these templates are policy artifacts, not project-shaped. Tests in .github/agents/tests/secret-gate.Tests.ps1 enforce manifest <-> body parity and assert allowlist coverage for PR #47 PII fakes + PR #49 fixtures.
